author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/5647400092. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted name across the top of a grey metal gate in Dakar, with a painted portrait of a woman (artwork) and 'COIFFURE' below it. The A-frame board at the right ('SALON DE COIFFURE PEDICURE MANICURE POSE ONGLE POSE CILE' and a phone number) and a parked car with its plate are distractors.

author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/4558428815. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Round red stencilled reserved-parking disc on a pole in Dakar naming the business 'AUX FINS PALAIS' around the top; the authorisation number runs around the bottom edge. The 'N°' is a stencilled N with a small raised o. Retro colour filter washes out the background; a car number plate behind is incidental.

author: Madison Gray
attribution: Photo: Madison Gray, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Faddiouth_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted municipal notice at the bridge to Fadiouth island. Only the header and decree line are transcribed; the remaining hand-lettered rules (no sitting on the bridge railings, no cars, no bicycles or two-wheelers in the village) mix upper and lower case irregularly and are left out. The blue 'KANE_PRODUCTION' photo-shop board behind is a distractor.

author: Adama Diop
attribution: Photo: Adama Diop, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_in_Agnam-Goly,_Senegal.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large rust-stained hand-painted board in two panels over the road into Agnam-Goly (Matam region): left panel for the social-security payment office (red down arrow), right panel for the Jean Collin dispensary (two red crosses). 'AGNAMGOLY' is written as one word; 'd'Etat' is small lowercase after 'MINISTRE'. The capital 'I's are drawn with a dot. A faint painted-over word is visible under 'DE LA RÉPUBLIQUE'.

author: Catjacket
attribution: Photo: Catjacket, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Linguere_sign.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: 'I [heart] LINGUÈRE' 3D letters on a red metal frame in Senegal flag colours (green 'I', heart and 'L', yellow 'INGU' with a green star on the N, pale pink 'ÈRE'); the grave accent sits above the first E. The school banner hanging below (Groupe Scolaire El Hadji Diabel NDIAYE) is a distractor.

author: Babacar Dioum
attribution: Photo: Babacar Dioum, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Road_signs_Senegal.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Roundabout advance-direction sign in Thiès on a sidewalk, black stencil letters on white with a roundabout diagram; reading order is top, right, lower right, left. Distance '150 m' in a box at lower right. Faded torn posters on the left half. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Babacar Dioum
attribution: Photo: Babacar Dioum, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Road_signs_for_different_routes_Senegal.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stacked direction sign in Thiès, one destination per panel with arrows; a metal frame crosses the right edge of 'PLACE DE SOUSSE' and the bottom panel is scratched. Different physical sign from c88966680 (stacked layout, not a roundabout diagram) though it lists the same places. A small pasted notice under 'KEUR ISSA' is illegible. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
